talents.name: Improved Gouge
talents.description: Increases the duration of your Gouge ability by 0.5 sec.

talents.name: Remorseless Attacks
talents.description: After killing a non-trivial enemy, gives you a 20% increased critical strike chance on your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Mutilate, or Ghostly Strike. Lasts 20 sec.

talents.name: Malice
talents.description: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks and Poisons by 1%.

talents.name: Ruthlessness
talents.description: Gives your finishing moves a 20% chance to add a Combo Point to your target.

talents.name: Murder
talents.description: Increases all damage dealt by 2% against Humanoid and Giant targets.

talents.name: Improved Slice and Dice
talents.description: Increases the duration of your Slice and Dice ability by 15%.

talents.name: Relentless Strikes
talents.description: Your finishing moves have a 20% chance per Combo Point to restore 25 Energy.

talents.name: Improved Expose Armor
talents.description: Reduces the Energy cost of your Expose Armor ability by 5, and refunds 1 Combo Point when cast with 5 Combo Points.

talents.name: Lethality
talents.description: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Sinister Strike, Gouge, Backstab, Mutilate, Ghostly Strike, and Hemorrhage abilities by 6%.

talents.name: Vile Poisons
talents.description: Increases the damage dealt by your poisons by 4% and gives your poisons an additional 8% chance to resist dispel effects.

talents.name: Cold Blood
talents.description: When activated, increases the critical strike chance of your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Eviscerate, or Mutilate by 100%.

talents.name: Improved Poisons
talents.description: Increases the chance to apply Poisons to your target by 2%, and gives Poison applications a 10% chance to not consume a charge.

talents.name: Vigor
talents.description: Increases your maximum Energy by 5.

talents.name: Mutilate
talents.description: Instantly attacks with both weapons for 75% weapon damage plus an additional 13 with each weapon. Damage increased by 20% against Poisoned targets. Awards 2 Combo Points.

talents.name: Improved Kidney Shot
talents.description: Enemies Stunned by your Kidney Shot ability take 5% increased damage from your poisons and attacks.

talents.name: Seal Fate
talents.description: Your critical strikes from abilities that add Combo Points have a 20% chance to add an additional Combo Point.

talents.name: Venom
talents.description: Finishing move that increases the damage of your Poisons by 30% and your chance to apply Poisons by 10%. Lasts longer per combo point: 1 point: 9 seconds 2 points: 12 seconds 3 points: 15 seconds 4 points: 18 seconds 5 points: 21 seconds

talents.name: Improved Eviscerate
talents.description: Increases the damage done by your Eviscerate ability by 7%.

talents.name: Improved Sinister Strike
talents.description: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sinister Strike ability by 3.

talents.name: Lightning Reflexes
talents.description: Increases your Dodge chance by 1%.

talents.name: Puncturing Wounds
talents.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Backstab by 10% and your Mutilate by 5%, and gives Backstab a 15% chance to add an additional Combo Point.

talents.name: Deflection
talents.description: Increases your Parry chance by 2%.

talents.name: Precision
talents.description: Increases your chance to hit with all attacks and Poisons by 1%.

talents.name: Endurance
talents.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Sprint and Evasion abilities by 30%.

talents.name: Riposte
talents.description: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 150% weapon damage and disarms the target for 6 sec.

talents.name: Improved Sprint
talents.description: Gives a 50% chance to remove all movement impairing effects when you activate your Sprint ability.

talents.name: Improved Kick
talents.description: Gives your Kick ability a 50% chance to Silence the target for 2 sec.

talents.name: Restless Blades
talents.description: Your damaging finishing moves reduce the remaining cooldown of your Adrenaline Rush, Blade Flurry, Evasion, Sprint, and Vanish abilities by 2 sec per combo point.

talents.name: Dual Wield Specialization
talents.description: Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 5%.

talents.name: Blade Flurry
talents.description: Increases your melee attack speed by 20% and your melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent. Lasts 15 sec.

talents.name: Hack and Slash
talents.description: Gives your melee weapon attacks a benefit depending on the weapon. Axe/Sword: Your successful melee attacks have a 1% chance to trigger an extra attack on the target. Dagger/Fist: Increases your critical strike chance by 1%. Mace: Your attacks ignore 3% of your target's armor.

talents.name: Weapon Expertise
talents.description: Reduces the chance for your attacks to be Dodged or Parried by 1%.

talents.name: Aggression
talents.description: Increases the damage of your Sinister Strike, Backstab, and Eviscerate abilities by 2%.

talents.name: Adrenaline Rush
talents.description: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 100% for 15 sec.

talents.name: Camouflage
talents.description: Reduces your speed penalty from your Stealth ability by 3% and reduces its cooldown by 2 sec.

talents.name: Master of Deception
talents.description: Reduces the chance enemies have to detect you while in Stealth mode as if you were 1 level higher.

talents.name: Opportunity
talents.description: Increases the damage dealt by your Backstab, Garrote, Ambush, and Mutilate abilities by 5%.

talents.name: Setup
talents.description: Gives you a 33% chance to add a Combo Point to your target after Dodging an attack or fully resisting a spell.

talents.name: Elusiveness
talents.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Vanish and Blind abilities by 45 sec.

talents.name: Dirty Tricks
talents.description: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sap and Blind abilities by 25%.

talents.name: Improved Ambush
talents.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Ambush ability by 15%.

talents.name: Initiative
talents.description: Gives you a 33% chance to add an additional combo point to your target when using your Ambush, Garrote, or Cheap Shot ability.

talents.name: Ghostly Strike
talents.description: A strike that deals 125% (180% if a Dagger is equipped in your Main Hand) weapon damage and increases your chance to dodge by 15% for 7 sec. Awards 1 combo point.

talents.name: Improved Distract
talents.description: Increases the radius of your Distract ability by 3 yds, and further reduces the Stealth detection of distracted enemies as though they were an additional 1 level lower.

talents.name: Heightened Senses
talents.description: Increases your Stealth detection as if you were 1 level higher and reduces your chance to be hit by spells and ranged attacks by 2%.

talents.name: Premeditation
talents.description: Adds 2 Combo Points to your target. You must add to or use those combo points within 20 sec or the combo points are lost.

talents.name: Serrated Blades
talents.description: Causes your attacks to ignore 3% of your target's Armor and increases the damage dealt by your Rupture ability by 10%.

talents.name: Dirty Deeds
talents.description: Reduces the Energy cost of your Cheap Shot and Garrote abilities by 10, and your Garrote ability no longer requires you to be behind your target.

talents.name: Preparation
talents.description: When activated, this ability immediately finishes the cooldown on your other Rogue abilities.

talents.name: Hemorrhage
talents.description: An instant strike that deals 100% weapon damage (145% if a Dagger is equipped) and causes the target to take 15% increased Rupture damage from the Rogue. Lasts 15 sec. Awards 1 Combo Point.

talents.name: Quietus
talents.description: Your Sinister Strike, Ghostly Strike, and Hemorrhage abilities cause 2% more damage against targets below 35% health.

talents.name: Cutthroat
talents.description: Your Backstab has a 3% chance to cause your next Ambush within 10 sec to not require Stealth.

talents.name: Thousand Cuts
talents.description: When your Rupture ability deals periodic damage, the Energy cost of your next Hemorrhage or Backstab ability within 10 sec is reduced by 3, stacking up to 5 times.
